metadata.title: 'Magnificent Seven' fund poised for breakout to record high, says Fundstrat - MarketWatch

content.text:
3 hours ago
'Magnificent Seven' fund poised for breakout to record high, says Fundstrat
The "Magnificent Seven" basket of mega technology stocks is on the verge of an imminent breakout that should spark a sharp rally in the large-cap tech sector, says Fundstrat.
In a note published late Monday, Mark Newton, Fundstrat's head of technical strategy, presented the chart above to show that the Roundhill Magnificent Seven exchange-traded fund is producing an ascending triangle "that is nearing resolution" and signaling a burst higher to likely fresh record highs.
The Magnificent Seven is made up of Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta Platforms, Microsoft, Nvidia and Tesla.
